name: @kiigame/monorepo
description: Monorepo for development of KiiGame, a lightweight adventure game engine
author: Eino Keskitalo

scripts.build: npm run build -w '@kiigame/kgae_ts' && npm run build -w '@kiigame/adventure_engine' && npm run build-dev -w '@kiigame/latkazombit'
scripts.pre-commit: npm run pre-commit -w '@kiigame/kgae_ts' && npm run pre-commit -w '@kiigame/adventure_engine' && npm run pre-commit -w '@kiigame/latkazombit'
